editorial.blurb: This Lincoln Park sushi destination delivers remarkably fresh fish and creative rolls in a modern, upscale setting that feels special whether you're stopping by for happy hour or marking a major milestone.
editorial.insiderTip: Come during happy hour to snag excellent deals on appetizers like the spicy-sweet eggplant tempura and rolls—no reservation needed if you're flexible on timing, though one is smart to have just in case.
